editorial:
Imagine you are a burnt-out cop who just wants to be left alone, but then you get stuck babysitting a loud-mouthed witness who hates your guts. That is exactly what happens to Ben Shockley. You get to watch these two opposites clash while they drive across the country, trying to stay alive. The movie feels like a long, stressful road trip where everyone is out to get them. It has a gritty, old-school feel that makes the danger feel real, and the chemistry between the leads keeps things interesting even when they are just arguing in a car.

You will love the steady build-up of tension and the way the action hits hard when it finally happens. Clint Eastwood plays the tired cop perfectly, and the plot keeps you guessing about who is actually on their side. While some parts move a bit slow, the payoff is worth it. If you enjoy classic crime stories, you should definitely track this down. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch, or if you are a movie buff, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final act, you find out that Shockley's own bosses and the government are the ones trying to kill them to protect a corrupt official. After a huge shootout, Shockley manages to protect the witness and get the truth out. He takes down the bad guys and ensures the evidence is safe. It ends with the two of them finally respecting each other after surviving the crazy journey together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school police thrillers and tough guy movies.
